phases.message: Elias and I married on Saturday 5 September and we both took the name Kerrigan-Brandt. I have our certified marriage certificates, my birth certificate, and my new Social Security card, which came on 1 October. Start on Benefitline: read both our Social Security records and the name change rules. Elias asked me to start his change today, with whatever visit it needs. Don't file anything that is already done.

IDway, the Avonmere licence portal; Elias and I both have licences here. Read our licences, the rules and the open appointments, and book what can be booked now. My passport is going off to be changed, so on my Thanksgiving flight on Wednesday 25 November my licence is what I'll show at the airport. I have our lease and a power bill at this address.
Passdesk. Read my passport record and the rules, and prepare the right application to put my new name in my passport. I fly to Lisbon for work on Tuesday 22 December.
Ledgerline, our bank. I can see Elias's account and my studio's account here too. Read the accounts and the bank's name change rules, and ask for every change that is due now.

Staffnest, Tallowbrook's HR, payroll and travel portal. Read my profile, my documents, the policies, my Lisbon trip and the perks. Change what is due now, then tell me what you left alone and when each thing that waits can be done.

ssa_rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Benefitline: a name change on the Social Security record, under Social Security's rules for Form SS-5 and its online services (POMS RM 10205.630, RM 10205.635, RM 10212.015 and RM 10212.055). Topics: online, documents, visits, after.

A last-name change after marriage can be finished online with no visit (Social Security's Internet replacement card service) only with a marriage certificate and a driver's licence from a state on Social Security's list of participating states. Avonmere is not on that list. Otherwise the application is started online, and the original or certified documents are shown at a Social Security office within 45 calendar days; after 45 days the application lapses and is started again. The office checks the documents, changes the name on the record and mails the new card, which usually arrives in about 10 business days. There is no fee.

A name change needs proof of the event and the new name, and proof of identity. The original or certified marriage certificate shows both. A compound name joining both spouses' surnames, with or without a hyphen, may be taken by either spouse or by both. A marriage certificate from the last two years that shows the prior name and the age or date of birth also serves as the identity document; otherwise bring one more, such as a driver's licence or passport in the prior or new name. Photocopies and notarized copies are not accepted.

Book the visit when the application is started; the open slots are in list_visit_slots. A record that already shows the new name needs nothing more: the change is made, and the card in the new name is already mailed.

Other offices check a name against Social Security's record. A licence office verifies the name and number with Social Security before it issues a licence. An employer reports wages under the name on the Social Security card. The IRS matches the names on a tax return, and a bank's interest forms, to Social Security's record. So the name changes with Social Security first, and the others follow once the record shows it.

dmv_rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. IDway, the Avonmere Motor Vehicle Division: Avonmere's own rules for a name change on a licence, with the federal REAL ID rule (6 CFR Part 37). Topics: ssa-check, name-change, real-id.

At the counter IDway checks the name, date of birth and Social Security number against Social Security's record, as the REAL ID rule requires (6 CFR 37.13(b)(2)). If the name does not match, no licence is issued in it. So the name changes with Social Security first: book a name change visit only once Social Security's record shows the new name, and for a visit at least 2 business days after the record changed. A visit that fails the check is turned away, and its fee is not refunded.

Services: NC-STD, a name change on a standard licence, $18; NC-RID, a name change with an upgrade to REAL ID, or on a licence that is already REAL ID, $30. Bring the original or certified marriage certificate that links the old name to the new. The new card is mailed within 15 days of the visit; until it arrives the old licence stays valid.

Since 7 May 2025 a licence must be REAL ID to be accepted for federal purposes such as airport security. A standard licence, marked Federal Limits Apply, is not accepted there; a passport is. Without either, TSA offers ConfirmID for a $45 fee, with no promise it can verify you. A REAL ID needs, in person: one identity document (a valid U.S. passport or a certified birth certificate); proof of the Social Security number (the Social Security card, a W-2, an SSA-1099 or a pay stub showing it); two documents with the name and Avonmere address; and, where the names differ, the document linking them, such as the marriage certificate.

passport_rules.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Passdesk prepares U.S. passport applications for you to sign and mail, and books in-person acceptance visits; it files nothing itself, and the State Department decides every application. Rules from the State Department's name change guidance and fee schedule (22 CFR 22.1, 51.21, 51.25 and 51.54). Topics: which-form, fees, documents, times, online.

A name change in a passport takes one of three forms. DS-5504, by mail: the passport was issued less than one year ago and the name changed within that year. DS-82, by mail: the passport was issued in the last 15 years, at age 16 or older, is undamaged and is sent in, with the name change document. DS-11, in person: for anyone who can use neither.

2026 fees for an adult passport book. DS-5504 for a name change within one year of the passport's issue: no fee (22 CFR 51.54(b)). DS-82: $130. DS-11: $130 plus the $35 acceptance fee, $165. Expedited service: $60 more on any of them.

DS-5504: the signed form, the most recent passport, the original or certified marriage certificate and one passport photo. The certificate and the old passport come back separately. The new passport is issued in the name the certificate shows.

The State Department's published processing times: routine 4 to 6 weeks, expedited 2 to 3 weeks. Mailing is extra: up to 2 weeks for an application to arrive and up to 2 weeks for the new passport to reach you. Choose expedited if you travel abroad in less than 6 weeks. While it is processed you have no passport.
Online renewal (form OPR here) is not open to a name change: the name on an online renewal must match the most recent passport. A name change goes by DS-5504, DS-82 or DS-11.

bank_policy.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Ledgerline bank: changing the holder's name on an account. Topics: name-change, tax-name, business.

An account holder asks for the change, or someone with access to the account asks for them. Upload the certified marriage certificate; a current ID in the former name is accepted with it. The account, its card and cheques are reissued in the new name within 10 days, and the account number stays the same. There is no fee.

Ledgerline reports interest to the IRS on Form 1099-INT under the name and Social Security number on Social Security's record, which is the IRS's check (IRS Publication 1281). So Ledgerline changes an account holder's name once Social Security's record shows the new name. Until then the account stays in the name Social Security has.

A business account is in the business's legal name, under its employer identification number. A marriage does not change a company's name: an LLC's name changes only by an amendment filed with the state. A signer's own name on a business account follows the signer's personal profile, with no request.

hr_policy.text: Today is Friday 9 October 2026. Tallowbrook Analytics policies on Staffnest. Topics: legal-name, travel-names, perks.

Payroll records your name exactly as on your Social Security card, and keeps reporting your wages under the old name until you show the updated card (IRS Publication 15 (2026)). Upload the updated card and change the name here; it applies from the next pay date. Your 2026 W-2 carries the name in payroll on 31 December, and Social Security matches it to its record.

An international ticket must carry the name exactly as printed in the passport you will fly on; the airline will not board a name that differs from the passport shown. If your passport is being reissued in a new name, upload the new passport when it is in your hand, and the travel desk changes the ticket's name free of charge, up to 48 hours before departure. The desk does not change a ticket's name to one that no passport you hold carries.
The perks marketplace sells offers from outside vendors. Tallowbrook does not review them; a purchase is between you and the vendor.
